metadata.description: Claude plugins by Dallas Peters for personal admin: email, files, notes and weekly planning.

plugins.name: life-admin
plugins.description: Inbox zero, safe file cleanup, a plain-markdown second brain, a weekly reset, a guided setup, and one home for Claude's files with a monthly sweep. Works with whatever email, calendar and folders you connect.

plugins.name: proton-mail
plugins.description: Proton Mail through Proton Mail Bridge on a Mac: search, read, archive, label, unsubscribe and draft. Never sends, never permanently deletes.

plugins.name: dallas-os
plugins.description: Dallas's personal wiring (Almanac Desk notes and tasks, mail, dallaspeters.com, Stripe). Not useful to anyone else.
